title: Full-Screen Art Mode Zoom
message:
• Pinch to zoom up to 400% on drawings in Art Mode for precision sketch lines.
• Seamless pan gestures let you work comfortably on intricate illustrations.

title: Checklist Strikethrough Shortcut
message:
• Tap any checklist checkbox to immediately strike through completed tasks.
• Finished tasks are gently muted to keep active tasks front and center.

title: Recycle Bin Auto-Purge Live
message:
• Notes in the Recycle Bin are safely kept for 30 days before auto-purge.
• Restore any accidental deletions with a single tap from the Bin modal.

title: Wall Aesthetic Showcase
message:
• Discover stunning minimalist wall themes curated by fellow users on Reddit.
• Visit [r/DigitalStickyNotesApp](https://www.reddit.com/r/DigitalStickyNotesApp/) to get inspired!

title: Custom Line Heights
message:
• Note text features tuned line heights that eliminate ascender and descender clipping.
• Clear, effortless typography across all screen densities.

title: Subtask Reordering Haptics
message:
• Drag and drop checklist items to reorganize priority with tactile haptics.
• Subtasks nest cleanly beneath parent tasks for complex workflows.

title: Fast Canvas Rendering Engine
message:
• Optimized matrix transforms allow hundreds of notes on wall without stutter.
• Zero lag when tossing or moving notes across high refresh rate displays.

title: Safe Multi-Device Transfer
message:
• Export your wall backup as a standard JSON file and move it to any new phone.
• Import restores all note positions, colors, folders, and checklists instantly.

title: Magnetic Wall Snap Lines
message:
• Turn on Grid Snapping in Settings to align notes into neat geometric rows.
• Magnetic guidelines assist you in maintaining structured, organized boards.

title: Typewriter Text Spacing
message:
• Enjoy authentic monospace proportions with the Special Elite font.
• Imparts timeless typewriter character to daily work notes and logs.

title: Share Ideas on Reddit
message:
• Have suggestions for new wall textures or widget shapes? Tell us on Reddit!

title: Freeze & Lock Sticky Note
message:
• Pin your most crucial notes in place so they remain stationary on the wall.
• Tap the lock icon in note options to freeze position and avoid accidental drags.

title: Home Launcher Widget Setup
message:
• Long-press on your device Home screen, open Widgets, and pick Digital Sticky Notes.
• Select any note from the widget pool to place it right on your launcher.

title: Zero Background Battery Drain
message:
• Hardware-accelerated drawing pipelines idle at 0% CPU consumption.
• Widgets refresh efficiently without keeping wake locks active in background.

title: Quick Date and Time Insertion
message:
• Tap the clock stamp icon while editing any note to insert the current timestamp.
• Ideal for meeting logs, project status updates, and journal entries.

title: Pastel Color Palette Tones
message:
• Warm honey, sage green, and lavender tones offer soft contrast that calms the eyes.
• Switch note paper tints anytime from the note bottom bar.

title: Folder Organization Best Practices
message:
• Keep distinct folders for Work, Personal, and Shopping to reduce wall clutter.
• Tap any folder header to customize its name for instant recognition.

title: High-DPI Canvas Snapshot Export
message:
• Export high-resolution PNG image captures of your sticky notes with sharp text.
• Convenient for emailing study cards or sharing to social media.

title: Predictive Android Back Navigation
message:
• Native Android back swipe smoothly dismisses menus and confirmation dialogs.
• Double-back navigation safely confirms before closing the application.

title: Direct Feedback Channel
message:
• Tap **Send Feedback** in Settings to compose an email directly to the developer.
• System diagnostics are automatically formatted for swift bug fixes.

title: 100% Private Offline Architecture
message:
• Your thoughts belong solely to you. Zero trackers, zero metrics, zero accounts.
• All sticky notes, drawings, and widgets stay strictly on your local device.

title: Clean Wall Minimalist Mode
message:
• Tap Clean Wall View in Settings to hide all button bars and navigation headers.
• Enjoy pure, uninterrupted contemplation of your ideas.

title: Recovering Notes from Recycle Bin
message:
• Accidentally deleted a note? Open the Bin from the action menu!
• Tap any note card to preview its content and tap **Restore** to put it back.

message:
• Drawing mode responds smoothly to touch velocity and stylus pressure.
• Sketch ideas, flowcharts, and diagrams with natural ink aesthetics.

title: Handwriting Cursive Script
message:
• Switch note font to Caveat cursive to bring warm personal warmth to notes.
• Scaled baseline alignment keeps handwriting script legible and charming.

title: Smooth 120Hz Display Physics
message:

• Inertial physics mimics the tangible feel of real physical paper.

title: Single-Tap Folder Dilution
message:
• Need to unpack all stacks? Use Dilute Stacks to unbundle notes instantly.
• All notes remain safe on your wall without losing any text or drawing data.

title: Locking Folder Cover Covers
message:
• Inside an open folder, long-press any note to pin it as the folder cover note.
• The cover note always displays on top when the folder is closed.
